spec.cutoff: filing and acceptance dates strictly before signal
spec.anchor: latest annual filing, no older filing or period fallback; exact SUB.period
spec.cash: same issuer, accession, filing date, form, FP=FY, exact start/end, USD; no absent zeros
spec.duplicates: exact identical facts deduplicated; contradictory values or dates rejected
spec.proxy: common repurchases minus disclosed common issuance; not total net payout
spec.options: separate, no aggregation without non-overlap evidence
spec.fcf: same period OCF minus nonnegative capex; no substitutes
spec.shares: positive same-filing common balance instants 330-400 days apart; raw ratio only
spec.split_adjusted_dilution: not accredited; no entity-attributed split evidence in snapshot
